test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The enemy, even if it is a child, is a __challenge__ and needs to be removed from his path.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"challenge"** means something that requires great mental or physical effort to be done successfully and therefore tests a person's ability. (चुनौती)

 
 
• **Example: **The marathon was a great challenge for all the participants.
 
 
 
• **"Solution"** refers to a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation. (समाधान)
 
 
• **Example: **Finding a solution to the complex equation took hours of effort.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'challenge'** is **'solution'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nuisance** (परेशानी): A person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble or problems.

 
 
• **Example: **The loud music from the party was a nuisance to the neighbors.
 
 
 
• **Threat** (खतरा): A person or thing likely to cause damage or danger.
 
 
• **Example: **The approaching storm is a serious threat to the coastal regions.
 
 
 
• **Problem** (समस्या): A matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with.
 
 
• **Example: **We need to find a way to solve this problem quickly.
